test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Penny wise and pound foolish

options.text: Careless with large amounts, but not small
An intelligent person who behaves foolishly
Dissipating money without caring about consequences

solution: The correct answer is **'Option 1'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Penny wise and pound foolish"** is an English idiom that refers to the act of being careful about small amounts of money while carelessly spending larger amounts, often resulting in more significant financial loss.(छोटी राशियों के साथ सतर्क, लेकिन बड़ी राशियों के साथ लापरवाह) • **Careless with large amounts, but not small: **This is the correct answer. • **It exactly matches** the meaning of the idiom "Penny wise and pound foolish". • The** idiom suggests **a lack of understanding of the bigger picture. Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *Careless with large amounts, but not small.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • Here are explanations for all options: • **To act like a fool:** Although the idiom contains the word "foolish", the phrase does not simply mean to act like a fool. It has a specific connotation related to financial management.(मूर्ख की तरह व्यवहार करना) • **An intelligent person who behaves foolishly: **This doesn't capture the specific context of careful and careless financial management that is expressed in the idiom.(एक बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति जो मूर्खतापूर्ण व्यवहार करता है) • **Dissipating money without caring about consequences: **This doesn't capture the full meaning of the idiom, which includes being careful with small amounts while being careless with larger ones.(परिणामों की परवाह किए बिना धन का विसर्जन करना) 3d:T6ef, The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**
